'''Guido's Tower''' was a monument located in [[Theed]], the [[capital]] [[city]] of [[Naboo]]'s [[human]] [[Naboo (people)|inhabitants]]. A tall, slim tower, it had a square plan, eight floors, and a flat roof. It was located along the bank of the [[Solleu River]], between the [[Banqueting rotunda|rotunda]] commissioned by the [[Earl of Vis]] and a parallelipipedic building with a portico. As of [[32 BBY]], at the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo]], Guido's Tower was one of the oldest structures in Theed.<ref name="SWCL" />
